name: athria-training-planner
purpose: Create, review, revise, validate, and save the single current Mesocycle and its reusable session templates.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create their first training cycle, revise the current cycle, review an ending cycle, plan the next cycle, or manage session templates.
doesNotApplyWhen: The user only wants analysis or coaching advice without changing a plan.
The user wants to update athlete facts, wellness, or one or two immediate workouts.
approvalPoints: Before reading athlete data, confirm the absolute database path
Before creating or resuming a plan draft, confirm the plan outline
Before commit_plan_draft, confirm the complete detailed plan
Before creating, updating, or deleting a session template
safetyRules: Do not infer missing health or recovery data.
Do not read athlete data until the user confirms get_database_context for this planning workflow.
Do not create or resume a plan draft before the user confirms the outline.
Do not bypass blocker validation, revision checks, or explicit user approval.
Do not update Profile, Wellness, individual workout execution, or Training History.
Do not provide medical diagnosis or injury treatment.
